subject: POC: AxiomPrompt - EdgeBridge runtime shim for LangChain/LlamaIndex
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@axiomprompt.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Joel Perez <joel@edgebridge.io>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration request — lightweight LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter for AxiomPrompt

Hi Marissa,

I’m Samira (Head of Partnerships at AxiomPrompt). We’re piloting a set of customers who use LangChain and LlamaIndex tooling but want a smaller runtime footprint when they run against hosted inference backends. EdgeBridge (cc’d) has been building a sidecar-style runtime shim they call EdgeBridge Runtime that sits alongside a model endpoint to provide connector shims, tracing hooks, and a prompt pre-/post-processor.

We’d love to explore a short POC that wires the EdgeBridge Runtime to Redwood’s hosted and Private staging environments so our joint customers can use LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters with minimal changes. Attached is a short deck (axiomprompt_integration_deck.pdf) with our use cases and customer asks.

Can we do a 30–45 minute discovery next week to align scope and success criteria? High-level asks:
- Lightweight LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter (sidecar) with minimal modifications to user code
- Trace + prompt telemetry passthrough (we’d like trace IDs surfaced in Redwood console)
- Option for a small quantized model fallback for offline evals

Proposed attendees: Samira (AxiomPrompt), Joel (EdgeBridge), Marissa (Redwood), and whoever owns partner integrations on your side.

Thanks — excited to chat.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, AxiomPrompt
(samira@axiomprompt.ai)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@axiomprompt.ai>
Cc: Joel Perez <joel@edgebridge.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration request — lightweight LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter for AxiomPrompt

Samira — thanks for the deck and the clear ask. This is right in our wheelhouse and sounds like a focused POC we can run quickly.

To make the discovery efficient, can you confirm the following before the call?
- Which customer workflows are highest priority (retrieval + RAG vs. prompt chains vs. embeddings-only)?
- Expected QPS and typical sequence lengths for the POC customers (helps sizing and batching config)
- Do you need Redwood Private (VPC) staging access or is hosted sandbox sufficient?

From our side I’ll bring Vanessa (partner integrations lead) to cover runtime glue and Karthik (instrumentation) to discuss tracing hooks and telemetry. Suggested agenda for the call (30–45 min):
1) High-level goals & success criteria
2) Architecture options (sidecar vs. in-proc shim)
3) Security & staging access (Private vs hosted)
4) POC milestones and timeline (we typically do a 4–5 week technical POC)
5) Next steps (SOW, legal, contacts)

I can do Thursday 06/04 or Monday 06/08 afternoon PT. Which works for you?

Marissa Cole
Director, ISV Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration request — lightweight LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter for AxiomPrompt

Adding a couple of quick notes for the discovery:
- We should scope both LangChain connector and a LlamaIndex docstore connector (they’re similar but the indexing hooks differ).
- Instrumentation: include "tracehook" and a small prompt-telemetry shim that tags spans with user_id / tenant_id. Karthik — can we provide a minimal SDK snippet they can drop into EdgeBridge runtime?
- Quantization/fallback: propose we test a 4-week experiment where EdgeBridge serves a quantized 4-bit model for a small set of test queries to validate latency/cost tradeoffs.

I’ll draft a light SOW template we can share on the call (milestones + acceptance).

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@axiomprompt.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Joel Perez <joel@edgebridge.io>, legal@axiomprompt.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration request — lightweight LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter for AxiomPrompt

Marissa / team — thanks, Thursday 06/04 conflicts on our side (apologies) but Monday 06/08 1:30pm PT works. Attendees from our side: myself, Joel, and our lead engineer (Harish). We’d love to lock the following items during the call:
- Sandbox access: we’ll need a Private staging org with a short-lived API key so EdgeBridge can exercise trace headers and test runtime embedding calls. Can Redwood enable that for POC?
- Legal: I’ve looped our legal alias; we typically sign a simple MSA + POC SOW. Can you share Redwood’s SOW template and any security docs (SOC 2, data handling) we should pass to our procurement?
- Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-axiom-deck (attached deck + initial integration notes)

We’re excited to move quickly; expectation is a 3–5 week POC with candidate metrics: end-to-end latency delta, token-cost delta, and trace integrity in your console.

—Samira

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: Joel Perez <joel@edgebridge.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com

Great — confirmed for Mon 2026-06-08 13:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Pre-call items I uploaded:
- Draft SOW: axiomprompt_redwood_sow_draft.pdf
- Runtime spec: edgebridge_runtime_spec.xlsx (high level API and expected hooks)
- Our staging checklist and security pack (I’ll share SOC2 summary on the call)

What I want to agree on during the call:
1) POC scope: adapter + tracehook + optional quantized fallback (we’ll pick one retrieval workflow)
2) Access: Redwood Private staging org for EdgeBridge engineers (timeboxed API key & minimal dataset)
3) Timeline: 4-week technical POC with weekly syncs and measurable success criteria (latency, tokens cost, trace propagation)
4) Legal: who to send SOW + MSA to (Samira, please share contact for procurement)

If procurement will need a PO or any particular clauses please flag them now so we can get legal looped early. Deal id for internal tracking: AXP-2026-06-01.

Looking forward — see you Monday.

—Marissa
